description: The bustling heart of downtown Alexandria, a lively district centered on the historic tram terminus and surrounded by colonial-era architecture, shops, and cafes. Its vibrant street life and vintage trams make it a memorable place to experience the city's everyday character.
address: Mahmoud Al Falaki, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372045

name: Tea island
description: A tranquil islet within the Montaza park complex, reached by a graceful bridge and once favored by King Farouk for enjoying tea by the sea. Its peaceful setting and sweeping Mediterranean views make it a lovely spot to relax, especially at sunset.
address: 72RC+MFG, Al Mandarah Bahri, Qesm Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: Ahmed Oraby Square
description: A grand historic square in the Mansheya district, laid out in the European style and long serving as a central gathering and commercial hub. Its handsome architecture and monuments make it a notable landmark in the old city center.
address: Al Mansheyah Al Kubra, Qesm Al Mansheyah, Alexandria Governorate 5361022

name: The Flying Sails and a Mermaid Statue
description: A modern seaside sculpture on the Corniche near the Bibliotheca, depicting a mermaid, an emblem long associated with Alexandria. Its waterfront setting makes it a pleasant landmark along a scenic stretch of the coast.
address: 6W55+WFW, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5424020

name: Beer Masoud
description: A well-known coastal spot in the Sidi Beshr area, centered on the legendary Masoud well and offering fresh sea air and open views of the Mediterranean. A traditional gathering place, it is popular for watching fishermen and enjoying the shore.
address: 7X9P+GJ5, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517268

name: Beau Rivage Promenade
description: A peaceful seaside promenade in the Sidi Beshr area, offering a quiet walk with open views of the Mediterranean. Its relaxed atmosphere and sea breeze make it a pleasant place for a stroll along the coast.
address: 7XCW+C2J, Street 2, Sidi Beshr Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5517283

name: Tabia Cosa Pasha
description: A historic coastal fortress in the Abu Qir area, preserving old cannons and defensive structures that recall the region's military past. Though modest in scale, it offers a glimpse into Alexandria's strategic maritime history.
address: 83F7+QHX, Toson, Abu Qir Ash Sharqeyah, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527441

name: Saad Zaghloul Statue
description: A grand statue near Raml Station honoring the nationalist leader Saad Zaghloul, sculpted by the renowned artist Mahmoud Mokhtar. Set in a seafront square at the heart of the city, it is a prominent monument overlooking the Mediterranean.
address: Raml Station Sq., Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

name: Qaitbay Promenade
description: A scenic stone promenade beside Qaitbay Citadel, stretching along the water at the tip of the eastern harbor. Recently renovated, it offers dramatic sea views and crashing waves, making it a favorite spot for a seaside walk.
address: 6V7M+563, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate

name: Al Qaaed Ibrahim Basha Mosque
description: One of Alexandria's most iconic mosques, built in the mid-twentieth century near Raml Station and named after Ibrahim Pasha. Its graceful minaret and central location make it a striking landmark and an important place of worship in the city.
address: 6W33+7G4, Mahta Al Raml Sq., Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373010

name: Alexandria Bibliotheca
description: A monumental modern library on the Mediterranean shore, built to commemorate the fabled ancient Library of Alexandria. Its striking circular architecture, vast reading hall, and museums make it one of the city's foremost cultural landmarks.
address: Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate 21526

name: Sidi Morsi Abu al-Abbas Mosque
description: One of Alexandria's largest and most revered mosques, located in the Anfoushi district and dedicated to the thirteenth-century Sufi saint Abu al-Abbas al-Mursi. Its Andalusian-inspired design and beautiful interior make it a spiritual and architectural highlight of the old city.
address: El Sayed Mohamed Karim St, Mosques Square, Bahary, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 21500

name: Alexandria Ancient Roman Theater
description: A remarkably preserved Roman-era amphitheatre at Kom El Dikka in the city center, complete with marble seating, baths, and lecture halls. This rare archaeological site offers a vivid window into Alexandria's ancient past.
address: Ismail Mahana Rd, opposite Misr Railway Station, Kom Ad Dakah Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 21517

name: Roman Villa of the Birds
description: An ancient Roman villa at the Kom El Dikka site, renowned for its beautifully preserved floor mosaics, including the bird motifs that give it its name. A refined glimpse of Roman domestic life, it is one of the city's finest small archaeological treasures.
address: 54 Safeya Zaghloul St, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

name: Serapeum of Alexandria
description: An ancient temple site in the Karmouz district, home to the towering Pompey's Pillar and the remains of one of antiquity's great religious complexes. Its historic ruins and underground passages offer a striking connection to Alexandria's classical age.
address: Pompey's Pillar, Al Karah WA at Toubageyah WA Kafr Al Ghates, Karmouz, Alexandria Governorate 5341142

name: Kom el Dikka
description: A major archaeological park in the city center encompassing a Roman theater, baths, and residential ruins, along with fascinating underwater-archaeology exhibits. Well laid out with informative signage, it is one of Alexandria's most rewarding historic sites to explore.
address: 5WV3+QVR, Ismail Mahana, Kom Ad Dakah Gharb, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5371040

name: Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa
description: An extraordinary underground necropolis in the Karmouz district, descending several levels beneath the city and blending Egyptian, Greek, and Roman styles. Reached by a spiral staircase, its richly carved tombs make it one of Alexandria's most remarkable ancient sites.
address: Kom El Shoqafa St, Karmouz, Alexandria Governorate

name: Antoniades Palace
description: A historic palace set within the lush Antoniades Gardens in Smouha, surrounded by classical statues and expansive green grounds. Though the palace interior is often closed, the calm, tree-filled park makes it a pleasant place to wander.
address: Izbat Saed Qesm, Sidi Gaber

name: Mustafa Kamel Hellenistic Necropolis
description: A little-known cluster of Hellenistic-era tombs in the Mustafa Kamel area, carved from rock and dating back more than twenty centuries. Tucked among the city's buildings, it offers a quiet and rewarding stop for those interested in ancient history.
address: 6WJX+72X, Al Moaaskar Al Romani, Mustafa Kamel WA Bolkli, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5434044

name: Anfushi Tombs
description: A set of well-preserved Ptolemaic-era tombs near Ras El Tin, dating to the third century BC and decorated with geometric patterns and Egyptian-style frescoes. Set in a quiet spot near Qaitbay, they offer an intimate look at ancient Alexandrian burial art.
address: 6V2F+RMW, Ibrahim Al Awal Sq., Ras at Tin, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321020

name: Greek Orthodox Cemetery
description: A historic cemetery in the Shatby area, home to elaborately carved graves and statuary dating back to the nineteenth century. Its atmospheric grounds reflect the rich legacy of Alexandria's once-thriving Greek community.
address: 6W38+X2C, Suez Canal Rd, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423020

name: The Alabaster Tomb
description: An ancient Ptolemaic-era tomb built of alabaster in the Shatby area, long associated with speculation about the burial of Alexander the Great. A quiet but intriguing archaeological monument, it offers a tangible link to the city's classical origins.
address: Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423020

name: El Montaza Gardens
description: The sprawling seaside gardens of the Montaza royal complex, filled with greenery, walking paths, and sweeping Mediterranean views. Open at all hours and dotted with cafes and beaches, it is a beloved place for strolls, cycling, and relaxed family outings.
address: 77 Gamal Abd El-Nasir Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5526048

name: Sir Allenby Garden
description: A leafy neighborhood park in the Kafr Abdou district, offering open green space amid the surrounding streets. A pleasant local retreat, it is a favorite spot for a quiet walk or a break from the city bustle.
address: 6XG4+35P, Abu an Nawatir, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5433124

name: Al Shalalat Park
description: A historic park in the city center built around old waterworks and remnants of the ancient city walls, with winding paths and greenery. One of Alexandria's oldest gardens, it offers a peaceful place for a stroll amid trees and water features.
address: 6W37+3RF, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423005

name: Antoniades Gardens
description: One of Alexandria's most celebrated historic gardens, located in Smouha and laid out in an elegant European style with old trees, flowers, and classical statues. Its wide, tranquil green spaces make it a favorite for walks, picnics, and quiet afternoons.
address: Albert El Awal St, Smouha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate

name: Kouta Park
description: A popular amusement park in the Maamoura area, offering a range of rides for both older thrill-seekers and younger children. Its lively, affordable atmosphere makes it a fun outing for families and groups.
address: El Maamoura Beach, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: Alexandria Zoo
description: One of Egypt's oldest and largest zoos, set within the Nozha gardens and home to a variety of animals across spacious, tree-shaded grounds. A long-standing city institution, it remains a popular destination for family visits.
address: Passage in Antonyades Palace, Ezbet Saad, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432034

name: Maamoura Amusement Park
description: A large amusement park in the Maamoura area, with a mix of thrill rides for adults and gentler attractions for children. Its wide range of games and festive atmosphere make it an enjoyable outing for families.
address: Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527101

name: Montaza Palace
description: A magnificent early-twentieth-century royal palace set amid the vast Montaza gardens on the Mediterranean coast. With its striking Turkish-Florentine architecture, sweeping sea views, and lush grounds, it is one of Alexandria's most beloved landmarks.
address: Montaza Palace, El-Gaish Rd, Al Mandarah Bahri, Montaza 2, Alexandria Governorate 5527001

name: Al Nozha Park in Alexandria
description: A large, established park in the Nozha area near the zoo, with old trees, open lawns, and space for family picnics. A budget-friendly green retreat, it is a pleasant place to relax and enjoy the outdoors.
address: Izbat Saed, Qesm Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5432034

name: Saad Zaghloul Park
description: A seafront park in the heart of downtown Alexandria, set in front of the historic Cecil Hotel with views over the Mediterranean. A well-known central landmark, it is a convenient spot for a stroll or a rest by the sea.
address: 6V2X+9QX, Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5373001

name: Alexandria Stadium Garden
description: A pleasant public garden beside the historic Alexandria Stadium, offering open green space and a monument amid the city center. Freely accessible and uncrowded, it is a nice spot for a quiet break outdoors.
address: 12 Omar Toson, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5370055

name: City Centre Alexandria
description: One of Alexandria's largest shopping and entertainment complexes, located on the Cairo-Alexandria Desert Road with a vast array of international and local stores. Its cinema, food court, arcade, and spacious layout make it a popular destination for shopping and family outings.
address: Cairo Alex Desert Rd, Qetaa at Tarik as Sahrawi, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5258730

name: Green Plaza Mall
description: A large shopping mall in the Sidi Gaber area combining retail, dining, and a cinema in a family-friendly setting. With its wide range of stores and restaurants, it is a favorite spot for shopping and spending an afternoon.
address: 14th of May Bridge Rd, Ezbet El-Nozha, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 5431116

name: San Stefano Grand Plaza
description: A major seaside shopping mall in the upscale San Stefano district, offering a wide variety of shops, a busy food court, and sea-facing surroundings. Its central location and extensive retail make it one of the city's most frequented shopping destinations.
address: El-Gaish Rd, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5452053

name: City Light Mall
description: A popular shopping mall in the Siouf area, home to a range of stores, cafes, and a hypermarket, along with an arcade for children. Its convenient location and varied shops make it a practical stop for shopping in eastern Alexandria.
address: El Qasem St, El Soyoof, Third Al Montazah, Alexandria Governorate 5515140

name: Matajer Mall
description: A modern, well-organized shopping mall in the Smouha area, known for its clean, comfortable layout, ample parking, and a children's play area. Its calm atmosphere and select dining spots make it a pleasant place for a relaxed family outing.
address: 51 Mohammed Fawzi Moaz St, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21648

name: Designia Mall
description: A compact, upscale mall near City Centre, home to international brands and a curated selection of restaurants and cafes. Its elegant, low-key atmosphere makes it a pleasant spot for dining and a relaxed shopping visit.
address: 5WFJ+67R, Unnamed Road, Qetaa at Tarik as Sahrawi, Amreya 1, Alexandria Governorate

name: Deeb Mall, Alexandria
description: A long-established multi-story shopping mall in the Sidi Gaber area, well known for its electronics and computer shops alongside clothing stores and a cinema. Its variety of goods makes it a practical destination for shoppers.
address: 1 Syria St, Sidi Gaber, Alexandria Governorate 21311

name: Falaky Center
description: A multi-story shopping center in the city center between Raml Station and Mansheya, filled with shops for clothing, accessories, and more. Its central location and mix of traditional and modern retail give it a distinctive local character.
address: 13 Mahmoud Pasha St, Mahmoud Al Falaki, Al Mesallah Gharb WA Sharif Basha, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

name: Alexandria National Museum
description: A refined museum housed in a restored Italian-style villa that once served as a foreign consulate, tracing the city's history from Pharaonic through Greco-Roman and Islamic times. Its elegant setting and well-chosen collection make it a rewarding stop for history lovers.
address: 131 El-Shaheed Galal El-Desouky, Bab Sharqi WA Wabour Al Meyah, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423004

name: Greco-Roman Museum
description: One of Alexandria's premier museums, dedicated to the city's Greco-Roman heritage with an extensive collection of statues, coins, and artifacts. Its well-presented displays and clear signage offer a fascinating journey through the classical age of Egypt.
address: Al Mesallah Sharq, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate 5372053

name: Royal Jewelry Museum Alexandria
description: A dazzling museum set in a lavishly decorated former royal palace in the San Stefano area, displaying the jewelry and personal treasures of Egypt's royal family. The ornate halls, stained glass, and exquisite collection make it a truly memorable visit.
address: 27 Ahmed Yehia, San Stefano, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5451010

name: Cavafy Museum
description: A small, atmospheric museum in the former apartment of the celebrated Greek poet Constantine Cavafy near Raml Station. With its personal documents and period furnishings, it offers an intimate glimpse into the poet's life and the city's cosmopolitan past.
address: Off Salah Moustafa St, Raml Station, Al Attarin, Alexandria Governorate

name: Mahmoud Said Museum
description: An art museum set in the elegant former family home of the pioneering Egyptian painter Mahmoud Said, showcasing his works alongside galleries of other notable artists. A quiet cultural gem, it is a delight for anyone interested in Egyptian modern art.
address: San Stefano, El Raml 1, Alexandria Governorate 5451102

name: Museum of Fine Arts, Alexandria
description: A cultural museum in the Moharram Bek area featuring a collection of European and Egyptian paintings and rotating exhibitions. Its intimate galleries and varied programming make it a worthwhile stop for art enthusiasts.
address: 5WW7+38V, El-Mohandes Ahmed Ismail, Emberouz WA Moharram Beik, Moharam Bek, Alexandria Governorate 5413416

name: Water Biology Exhibition
description: A marine museum located within the grounds of Qaitbay Citadel, displaying preserved sea and river species, birds, and even a whale skeleton. Its compact, informative exhibits make it an interesting addition to a visit to the citadel.
address: 6V7P+728, As Sayalah Sharq, Al Gomrok, Alexandria Governorate 5321431

name: The Archaeological Museum in the Bibliotheca Alexandria
description: A well-curated antiquities museum within the Bibliotheca Alexandrina, displaying artifacts from the Pharaonic, Greco-Roman, and Islamic periods. Its thoughtful presentation makes it a rewarding complement to a visit to the great library.
address: 13 El Zarkashy St, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Sharq, Alexandria Governorate

name: Ras el Soda Temple
description: A small, well-preserved Greco-Roman temple relocated to the Shatby area, originally built as an offering of thanks to the goddess Isis. Though not always open inside, its columns and platform can be admired from the surrounding grounds.
address: 6W39+7GR, Al Azaritah WA Ash Shatebi, Bab Shar', Alexandria Governorate 5423020
